phrases.english: Blow hard, and blow out the candles!

phrases.latin: Quot candēlae sunt in lībō? Trēs, quia trēs annōs nātus es.
phrases.english: How many candles are there on the cake? Three, because you’re three.

sources: Lewis & Short: candela · Lewis & Short: exstinguo · Lewis & Short: flo
